title: Read the browser version verdict
description: Whether this DSphere browser is new enough to run tasks: it must be newer than 6.6.70.284, which is itself too old.
guidance: upgrade-required means every call that opens or drives a page, starts a wizard or runs a workflow is refused (UNSUPPORTED_VERSION, BROWSER_UPGRADE_REQUIRED) until the person updates the browser: tell them to choose Check Update at the top right of the Work portal, then restart the browser; do not retry or try another browser. Reads, settings and dsagent.agent.work.finish still work. Ignore fields and status values you do not know. Read-only; nothing is opened.

running.description: The browser's version, left out when it cannot be read.

minimum.description: The newest version that is still too old: the browser must be newer than this, and this version itself is refused.

status.description: supported: tasks can run; upgrade-required: the person must update the browser first. Later versions may add values.

backgroundRendering.description: Whether the browser can keep task pages drawing in the background.

upgradeEntrance.description: Where the person updates the browser: Check Update at the top right of the Work portal.

hint.description: What to tell the person, in English.
